title: Security claims and device-operation capability evidence register
classificationRule: Only traceable repository or hosted validation evidence may be Verified; otherwise use the more conservative status.

claims.claim: Knox certification or Knox hardware integration
claims.evidence: Issue #63 records no Samsung certification or Knox integration evidence; public RootMaster surface disabled.
claims.limitation: No supported-device matrix or vendor attestation evidence.

claims.evidence: No device-attestation implementation or approved device evidence in this repository.
claims.limitation: A software emulator is not hardware-backed evidence.

claims.evidence: No independent certification record is present in the repository.
claims.limitation: Documentation must not present certification as a fact.

claims.claim: Firmware flashing, bootloader unlock, rooting, bypass, fuse, register modification, or recovery operation
claims.evidence: The public/operator RootMaster route is replaced with a non-operational unavailable screen.
claims.limitation: Educational references may remain only outside executable operator controls and must be qualified.

claims.evidence: No callable control remains in the public RootMaster route.
claims.limitation: No implementation or authorization evidence exists.

claims.evidence: Repository documentation identifies AcingVaultEmulator.kt as software emulation for development.
claims.limitation: Not evidence of TrustZone, Secure Enclave, Knox Vault, or production hardware.

claims.evidence: Issue #63 and the Phase 6 audit identify unresolved claim mapping and release gates.
claims.limitation: Build and tests do not establish deployment or release readiness.
